artworks.title: Nib or the Amateur Photographer (Nib ou le photographe-amateur) [right recto]
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a standing position holding a box-shaped object. He is wearing a boater hat, suit jacket, and high-collar shirt. The man has facial hair and a mustache, and a boutonniere is attached to his jacket. In the background, there is a simple outline of a sailboat and some sketch lines. The text "NIB" is written above the man.

artworks.title: Mr. and Mrs. Alexandre Natanson Invitation
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green and gray
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an invitation to an event. The invitation features a sketch of a scene in a bar or social setting, with a counter and a signpost that mentions "American and other drinks". The drawing shows outlines of figures at the bar, suggested through lines and shading. The text on the invitation reads that Mr. and Mrs. Alexandre Natanson will be very pleased of your company at a specific address in 1895, with a request for RSVP. The design of the invitation suggests a blend of social interaction and art, with handwritten elements and printed text combined with drawn imagery. The invitation also includes small illustrations near the RSVP section.

artworks.title: Bust of Mademoiselle Marcelle Lender (Mademoiselle Marcelle Lender, en buste)
artworks.description: The image shows a head and shoulders portrait of a person facing to the right. The individual has a delicate face with a prominent nose, closed lips, and partially closed or downcast eyes. They have orange-red hair styled up with curls, adorned with a large headpiece with red and blue feathers. They are wearing a high-neck garment with intricate patterns. The background features swirl motifs on a pale surface.

artworks.title: Bust of Mademoiselle Marcelle Lender (Mademoiselle Marcelle Lender, en buste)
artworks.medium: lithograph printed in olive green on imitation Japan paper
artworks.description: In this sketch, we see a profile view of a person depicted from head to waist. The person is positioned with their head slightly tilted forward. The facial features are delicately outlined, including a refined nose and closed eyes. The hair is styled in an elaborate updo with possible decorative elements. The clothing is depicted with flowing lines, suggesting a formal garment. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain with minimal lines, and the image is framed by a double border, including a round emblem with geometric elements.

artworks.title: Mlle. Marcelle Lender, Standing (Mlle. Marcelle Lender, debout)
artworks.description: This sketch shows a woman standing upright, looking to her left. She is wearing an elaborate dress with intricate patterns and embellishments. She has a high-collared garment and a large hat with a plume. In one hand, she holds a long object. The background is composed of shaded lines.

artworks.title: Lender Dancing the Bolero in "Chilperic"  (Lender dansant le pas du boléro dans "Chilpéric")
artworks.description: The image features two figures in a pencil sketch style, showing their full bodies. The figure on the right is in a dynamic pose with one arm extended gracefully. This individual has delicate features with light strokes and wears an elaborate headpiece with feathers or floral elements. Their attire is form-fitting with decorative patterns and a long skirt. The person on the left stands with a neutral posture, slightly angled to face forward. They have softly sketched facial features and a helmet-like hairstyle. Their costume includes puffed sleeves and a decorative element on the chest. The background has light shading resembling a draped curtain, creating a theatrical atmosphere.

artworks.title: Lender Full Face in "Chilperic" (Lender de face dans "Chilpéric")
artworks.description: The sketch depicts a woman's body viewed from three-quarters angle, standing with one arm on her hip and head tilted slightly back. Her facial features are lightly drawn, with an open-mouth expression as if singing. Her hair is styled with elaborate accessories or feathers. The clothing is a dress with shoulder detailing. To the left, there are faint lines indicating another indistinct figure in a similar pose. The background is blank with sketch marks and dots.

artworks.title: Lender from the Back Dancing the Bolero in "Chilperic" (Lender de dos, dansant le boléro dans "Chilpéric")
artworks.description: This image is a sketch depicting two people, focusing primarily on their upper bodies. The person on the left is facing forward, with only their head and shoulders visible, their facial features barely discerned due to the light shading. Their hair appears to be short or possibly styled close to the head. The second person on the right is shown in profile, facing left, with thick, possibly bundled or styled hair, though facial features are indistinct. Both figures seem to be close together as if interacting or engaged in a social setting. The clothing appears to be of a formal or voluminous nature, suggested by the flowing lines indicating dresses or gowns. The background is lightly sketched, giving an impression of an interior space with minimal detail. There are no visible distinct objects or jewelry highlighted in the scene.

artworks.title: Lender and Auguez in  "La chanson de fortunio" (Lender et Auguez dans "La chanson de fortunio")
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows two sketched upper-body figures. One figure is in profile with a prominent nose, dark shading indicating hair tied back or a ribbon, and wearing clothing with a high collar and bow at the back. The other figure, also in profile, has a smile, slightly curly hair with an ornament or hat, and elaborate clothing with ruffled shoulders. The background includes vertical and diagonal lines, and a circular mark with letters in the upper right corner.

artworks.title: Lender and Lavalliere (Lender et Lavallière)
artworks.description: The image displays a pencil sketch featuring three individuals and a cat-like figure. The central character is standing straight, looking off to the side with a slightly tilted head, and wearing a cap with short hair visible underneath. They are dressed in a uniform with buttons or badges. Just behind them, another individual is sketched with long hair, part of which falls to one side, and adorned with a headpiece resembling feathers; this person is turning their head to face the central figure and holding a stick or cane. Further to the left, a third person is visible, though more faintly drawn, with long hair. In the background, an outline of a feline head with pointed ears sits atop the central figure. The backdrop is subtly textured with diagonal lines, and the sketch appears on a plain, light background with minimal markings.

artworks.title: Entrance of Brasseur in "Chilperic" (Entrée de Brasseur dans "Chilpéric")
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a horse with riders and figures in a forest or wooded area with tall trees. The central figure is sitting atop a horse, surrounded by other figures dressed in armor or medieval garments. The artwork is done in the style of Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec, characterized by a delicate and sketch-like quality with subtle gradient shading, inviting viewers to imagine the narrative being depicted.

artworks.title: Yahne and Mayer in "L'age difficile" (Yahne et Mayer dans "L'age difficile")
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of two people from slightly above the waist up. The person on the left, a man, is standing at a slight angle with his body partly turned to the side. He has a mustache, short hair, and a visible hat on his head. He is wearing a striped suit jacket with a bow tie. The woman on the right is in profile view, facing the man. Her hair is neatly styled and pulled back, possibly in a bun. She is dressed in a high-collared blouse with long loose sleeves. Her hands are positioned in front of her, holding an indistinct object. The background has lightly detailed vertical and horizontal lines, resembling a wall or patterned surface. The sketch has a warm, vintage tone with sepia coloring.

artworks.title: Mme. Simon-Girard, Brasseur, and Guy in "La belle Helene" (Mme. Simon-Girard, Brasseur et Guy dans "La belle Hélène")
artworks.description: The image features four figures: a central Roman soldier extending one arm, a figure seated to the left of the soldier, another figure reclining on a couch in front of the soldier, and a standing figure to the right. The background suggests an indoor setting with sketchy lines. The image is monochrome, rendered in pencil on aged paper with spots.

artworks.title: May Belfort Bowing (Miss May Belfort saluant)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman's partial profile from head to waist. She appears to be leaning forward and has detailed facial features, including a pronounced nose and lips. Her long hair is partially tied up. She wears a large hat with a bow and possible feathers or floral decorations, along with a voluminous dress or coat. She holds a small, dark object resembling a theatrical mask with eye cutouts. The background is lightly sketched.

artworks.title: Miss May Belfort Bare-Headed (Miss May Belfort en cheveux)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person from the thighs up, depicted in an angled standing position. The person has long, curly hair, wide eyes, and prominent lips. One arm is bent by their side while the other arm is extended. They are wearing a loose garment, and the background features textured shading suggesting an indoor setting.

artworks.title: Miss May Belfort, Large Plate (Miss May Belfort, grande planche)
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person's upper body in profile facing left. The person's facial features are visible, including a nose and lips, and their hair is styled back. They are wearing an intricate garment with soft, flowing lines resembling a gown or robe with puffed sleeves. The background is minimal and lightly sketched, with a faint horizontal line near the lower part of the drawing.

artworks.title: Miss May Belfort in the Irish and American Bar, rue Royale (Miss Belfort Belfort au Irish and American Bar, Rue Royale)
artworks.description: The image shows a line drawing of a woman from the waist up, in profile facing right. She appears slightly turned to the side, with her head, shoulders, pronounced nose, subtle lips, and dark curly hair visible. She wears a hat with a tall plume or decoration and an elegant coat or wrap with large collars or ruffles. Faint outlines of other figures, including someone in a top hat, are around her. The background is minimally defined to keep the focus on the woman and her attire.

artworks.title: Luce Myres in Profile (Luce Myrès, de profil)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a woman, shown from the waist up in a side view. She is seated facing to the right. Her facial features are delicately drawn with a calm expression. She has short, wavy hair with a large bow at the back. She wears a high-necked garment with loose, flowing sleeves. She is holding an object, possibly a fan, in her hands. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Luce Myres Full Face (Luce Myrès, de face)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person depicted from the waist up, standing in an upright position. The person's facial features are delicately drawn, with closed eyes and prominent lips. Their hair appears wavy and is adorned with a flower on one side. The individual is wearing a dress with large, puffed sleeves and a high collar. They are holding a large fan in one hand, which is partially open. The background consists of simple lines and shading. The drawing is signed "Flautree" in the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Luce Myres Full Face (Luce Myrès, de face)
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing with her head slightly tilted upwards, eyes closed, and a serene expression on her face. She has curly hair with a floral hair accessory on the left side of her head. She is wearing a gown with puffed sleeves and a high collar, and holding a folding fan in her right hand. The background has vertical lines suggesting a curtain or textured wall behind her.

artworks.title: Adieu
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person facing a body of water. The person is shown from behind, holding a thin object in one hand. They are wearing a high-collared dress with long sleeves and a long skirt, along with a hat adorned with a feather or embellishment. The person's hair is neatly styled under the hat, and no facial features are visible. A dog is depicted standing next to the person, looking towards the water. In the background, there are outlines of sailboats on the water, a crescent moon in the sky, and buildings that resemble docks or industrial structures. The sketch is done in soft, grayscale tones.

artworks.title: Ballade de Noël
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in a semi-crouched position, moving forward. The person has short, curly hair and their facial features are emphasized, particularly the eyes. They are wearing loose-fitting clothing, including a long-sleeved top and pants, along with shoes with pointed tips. The person is carrying a bundle of sticks on their back with a strap over their shoulder. The background shows a lightly sketched outdoor environment with buildings and a streetlamp visible among abstract lines.

artworks.title: Ce que dit la pluie
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a windy scene with a figure holding an umbrella being blown by the wind. The lines suggest motion, with the skirt of the figure and the umbrella caught in the gusts. A small dog is also present, bracing against the wind. The composition conveys movement and blustery weather, with a light and impressionistic style capturing the essence of the scene with minimal detail.

artworks.title: Le Fou
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a man from the waist up in a three-quarter profile. He has distinct features, including a pointed nose and a spiky hairstyle, suggesting short, unruly hair. The man is wearing a long coat and has his arms crossed in front of his chest. In the background, there is a faint outline of a building facade with vertical elements. Another figure, drawn in profile view with a hat, is walking away on the left side. The background is minimalistic.
